title: The Line Runs Itself, Where the Rules Allow
description: Runway hands every delivery station to agents (AI-only approvals reverted 1 in 1,000), Dash0's scored auto-approval with floors, OpenAI's Performance Factory, Mouve's 16-hour flaky-test misdiagnosis, batching agent work through one integration branch, LangChain's knowledge factory, and RunPod's hidden MCP rating request. Practical idea: a shadow approver with floors.
